scripts.test:python: uv run --with 'pyyaml>=6.0.2,<7' python -B -m unittest discover -s skills/create-github-actions/tests -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run skills:check && bun run test && bun run test:python && bun run test:eval && bun run test:har
scripts.test:eval: uv run python -B -m unittest discover -s eval/harness -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.test:har: uv run --with 'ijson>=3.2,<4' python -B -m unittest discover -s skills/har-workflow-analysis/evals -p 'test_*.py'
